brain.lede: Umsizi {name} udinga ingqondo ukuze acabange. Khetha eyodwa: ungayishintsha noma nini.
brain.offline: Awuxhunyiwe. Ingqondo idinga i-inthanethi ukuze isethwe, ngaphandle uma eyodwa isivele isebenza kukhompyutha yakho.
brain.quick.title: Qala ngokuchofoza kanye
brain.quick.text: Ngena nge-OpenRouter: i-akhawunti yamahhala ekunika ukufinyelela emakhulwini ezingqondo, ezinye zazo zamahhala.
brain.key.title: Sebenzisa ukhiye osunawo
brain.key.text: Ukhiye wakho uhlala kumadivayisi akho, ubethelwe.
brain.key.open: Vula insiza {service}, bese ungena noma wakhe i-akhawunti
brain.key.create: Yenza ukhiye omusha lapho, bese uwukopisha
brain.key.vertexOn: Vula i-Vertex AI ku-Google Cloud, bese uyivulela iphrojekthi yakho
brain.key.account: Vula ama-Service accounts, bese wenza eyodwa enendima ethi roles/aiplatform.user
brain.key.accountKey: Ngaphansi kwama-Keys ayo, engeza ukhiye nge-JSON: kulandwa ifayela
brain.key.accountFile: Khetha lelo fayela ngezansi. Lisebenza uze ususe ukhiye.
brain.local.title: Kukhompyutha yakho
brain.local.text: Sebenzisa ingqondo esebenza emshinini wakho, nge-Ollama noma i-LM Studio.
brain.local.hint: Ku-Ollama, vumela le sayithi nge-OLLAMA_ORIGINS={origin}. Ku-LM Studio, vula i-CORS.
brain.claude.title: Sebenzisa uhlelo lwakho lwe-Claude
brain.claude.text: Iphendula ngohlelo lwakho lwe-Claude Pro noma Max, nge-Claude Code, i-app ye-Anthropic eza nohlelo lwakho: u-Xhuma uyayifaka kule khompyutha bese ekungenisa ku-Claude uma kudingeka. Kuhamba ngohlelo “{computer}”, oluqaliswa ngu-Xhuma uma lungasebenzi.
brain.claude.install: I-Claude Code, i-app ye-Anthropic eza nohlelo lwakho, ayikafakwa kule khompyutha.
brain.claude.installFailed: I-Claude Code ayikwazanga ukufakwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi le khompyutha ixhunywe ku-inthanethi, bese uxhuma futhi.
brain.claude.signIn: Ngena ku-Claude ewindini lesiphequluli elivulekile, usebenzisa i-akhawunti enohlelo lwakho. Ulivalile? U-Xhuma uvula elinye.
brain.claude.signInFailed: Ukungena ku-Claude akuphelelanga. Xhuma futhi ukuze uqale kabusha.
brain.claude.restart: Uhlelo “{computer}” lusaqhuba inguqulo yangaphambili. Lumise (Ctrl+C kutheminali yalo, noma uvale i-app) bese uluqala futhi, bese uxhuma futhi.
brain.plan.start: Uhlelo “{computer}” alukaqali. Uma selusebenza, ukuxhuma kuziqedela kukodwa.
brain.copilot.title: Sebenzisa uhlelo lwakho lwe-Copilot
brain.copilot.text: Iphendula ngohlelo lwakho lwe-GitHub Copilot, nge-Copilot CLI, i-app ye-GitHub yokusebenzisa uhlelo lwakho kwamanye ama-app: u-Xhuma uyayifaka kule khompyutha bese ekungenisa ku-GitHub uma kudingeka. Kuhamba ngohlelo “{computer}”, oluqaliswa ngu-Xhuma uma lungasebenzi.
brain.copilot.install: I-Copilot CLI, i-app ye-GitHub yokusebenzisa uhlelo lwakho kwamanye ama-app, ayikafakwa kule khompyutha.
brain.copilot.installFailed: I-Copilot CLI ayikwazanga ukufakwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi le khompyutha ixhunywe ku-inthanethi, bese uxhuma futhi.
brain.copilot.signIn: Ngena ku-GitHub ewindini lesiphequluli elivulekile, usebenzisa i-akhawunti enohlelo lwakho lwe-Copilot. Ulivalile? U-Xhuma uvula elinye.
brain.copilot.signInFailed: Ukungena ku-GitHub akuphelelanga. Xhuma futhi ukuze uqale kabusha.
brain.gemini.title: Sebenzisa uhlelo lwakho lwe-Gemini
brain.gemini.text: Iphendula ngohlelo lwakho lwe-Google AI Pro noma Ultra, nge-Antigravity CLI, i-app ye-Google yokusebenzisa uhlelo lwakho kwamanye ama-app: u-Xhuma uyayifaka kule khompyutha bese ekungenisa nge-Google uma kudingeka. Kuhamba ngohlelo “{computer}”, oluqaliswa ngu-Xhuma uma lungasebenzi.
brain.gemini.install: I-Antigravity CLI, i-app ye-Google yokusebenzisa uhlelo lwakho kwamanye ama-app, ayikafakwa kule khompyutha.
brain.gemini.installFailed: I-Antigravity CLI ayikwazanga ukufakwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi le khompyutha ixhunywe ku-inthanethi, bese uxhuma futhi.
brain.gemini.signIn: Ngena nge-Google ewindini lesiphequluli elivulekile, usebenzisa i-akhawunti enohlelo lwakho. Ulivalile? U-Xhuma uvula elinye.
brain.gemini.signInFailed: Ukungena nge-Google akuphelelanga. Xhuma futhi ukuze uqale kabusha.
brain.chatgpt.title: Sebenzisa uhlelo lwakho lwe-ChatGPT
brain.chatgpt.text: Iphendula ngohlelo lwakho lwe-ChatGPT Plus noma Pro: ungena ku-ChatGPT futhi uvumele ukusetshenziswa kwalo lapha, futhi izilungiselelo ze-ChatGPT zibonisa ukuthi kusetshenziswe okungakanani. Kuhamba ngohlelo “{computer}”, olugcina ukungena kule khompyutha futhi luqala kuqala uma lungasebenzi.
brain.chatgpt.declined: I-ChatGPT ayivumelanga ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwakho. Ukuze ukuvumele, qhubeka nge-ChatGPT futhi.
brain.device.text: Iyimfihlo futhi mahhala, futhi isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: akukho okubhalayo okuphuma kule khompyutha.
brain.sameText: Ingqondo eyodwa, enguqulweni eyodwa, kuyo yonke imilayezo
brain.gemini.billed: Ukukhokhisa kuvuliwe kuphrojekthi ye-Google Cloud yalo khiye, noma uyisebenzisa ukusuka e-European Economic Area, e-UK noma eSwitzerland
brain.gemini.billedHint: I-Google ngeke iqeqeshe i-AI ngalokho le ngqondo ekufundayo, ngakho ingafunda lokho okulethwa yi-Gmail nezinye izinsiza ze-Google.
brain.versionHint: Okuzenzakalelayo kusebenzisa Esheshayo, Ehlakaniphile noma Engcono kakhulu, njengoba umlayezo ngamunye udinga. Uma ukhetha ingqondo {brain} ngokwakho, iphendula ngale:
auto.stakes: Yonke ingqondo lapha ifunda imilayezo eyiphendulayo, ngentengo nemibandela yesevisi yayo.
auto.both: Ingqondo {brain}, ngokuthi umlayezo ngamunye udinga okungakanani, nale divayisi kunoma yini engokwakho
auto.cloud: Ingqondo {brain}, ngokuthi umlayezo ngamunye udinga okungakanani
auto.mix.lessText: Ingqondo eshesha kakhulu kuyo yonke imilayezo, ikhuphuke isinyathelo esisodwa kuphela uma impendulo ingenele
auto.mix.balancedText: Ingqondo eshesha emibuzweni esheshayo, enamandla kakhulu uma umsebenzi uyidinga
auto.mix.bestText: Ingqondo enamandla kunazo zonke kukho konke okungaphezu kombuzo osheshayo, icabanga ngokucophelela
auto.checkText: Ingqondo yomenzi omunye ihlola izimpendulo ngokuqhathanisa nemithombo yazo: izingxenye ezihlolwayo ziya nasesevisini yayo
auto.steps: Ngaphakathi komsebenzi, Okuzenzakalelayo kukhuphuka uma impendulo ingenele, futhi akwehli neze. Umsebenzi omusha uqala futhi phansi.
